## Terms

### Performance Advisor

- **Performance Advisor** · self — Performance Advisor is only available on M10+ clusters and Flex clusters; the Atlas-managed slow-query threshold is disabled on Free (M0) clusters and unsupported on clusters with MongoDB Search enabled. · aka: performance advisor, Performance Advisor, index suggestions, suggested indexes, index recommendations, recommended indexes, schema suggestions, schema anti-patterns, drop index suggestions, Drop Index Suggestions, redundant indexes, Auto-Index, auto-index, impact score, Impact — https://mongodb.com/docs/atlas/performance-advisor

### Query Insights

- **Query Insights** · part — Query Insights is a section in the Atlas cluster sidebar that combines Namespace Insights (collection-level latency) and the upgraded cluster-centric Query Profiler; Query Shapes is the default tab. The launch blog is dated 2024-05-02. · aka: Query Insights, query insights, Query Profiler, query profiler, Namespace Insights, namespace insights, Slow Queries, slow queries, slow query, profiler, Query Shapes, query shape, query statistics, $queryStats, Hot Collections, hot collections, Atlas Query Profiler — https://mongodb.com/blog/post/elevating-database-performance-introducing-query-insights-mongodb-atlas

### Atlas Search vs text search

- **Atlas Search vs text search** · contrast · aka: Atlas Search, $search, $text, text index, text search, full-text search, full text search, search index, Lucene, autocomplete, when to use Atlas Search, Atlas Search vs, $regex

### index

- **index** · related — Index field order is chosen by operator type: equality, then $in array, range, $type, $exists, other operators, then sort last; fields are generally ranked by cardinality. This differs from the ESR rule (equality, sort, range) that manual design uses, so check suggested order against sort-bearing qu · aka: indexes, indexed, IXSCAN, COLLSCAN, explain, executionStats, create index, createIndex — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/performance-advisor/index-ranking/

### query optimization

- **query optimization** · hypernym — Query optimization can occur both during development and later as your data usage and demand changes. As collections grow, a periodic review of query performance can help determine when clusters need to scale up or scale out. · aka: query performance, optimize queries, query optimizer, analyze query performance, slow query, performance — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-optimization/
